messages.author: cd76564ddb5e3c29
messages.subject: Inla() stuck at model fit
parts:
Hi, 
I am trying to fit spatiotemporal models with poisson and negative binomial likelihoods. 
The poisson model runs fine, but fitting the negative binomials model. my R session is getting stuck and when manually stopping it gives me the following:

inla.core.safe:  The inla program failed, but will rerun in case better initial values may help. try=1/1
inla.core.safe:  rerun with improved initial values 

Could I please know what's causing this? and how to resolve it. 
Here is my  code:

f1.RW1 <- obs ~ f(ID.area, model="generic1", Cmatrix=Q.Leroux, constr=TRUE, #sum-to-zero constraint
                             hyper=list(prec=list(prior=sdunif),beta=list(prior=lunif))) +
                        f(ID.month, model="rw1", constr=TRUE,
                          hyper=list(prec=list(prior=sdunif))) +
                        f(ID.area.month, model="iid", constr=TRUE,
                          hyper=list(prec=list(prior=sdunif)))

This runs fine: 
strategy <- "simplified.laplace"
poiss1.RW1.all <- inla(f1.RW1, family="poisson", data=data.all, E=E,
                  control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE, cdf=c(log(1)), link =1), 
                  control.compute=list(dic=TRUE, cpo=TRUE, waic=TRUE),  
                   control.inla=list(strategy=strategy))

But this is getting stuck
nb1.RW1.all<-  inla(f1.RW1,          #this failed to compute
              family = "nbinomial", data = data.all, E = E,
              control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE, cdf=c(log(1)), link =1),
              control.compute=list(dic=TRUE, cpo=TRUE, waic=TRUE),  
              control.inla=list(strategy=strategy)
              )

Thank you

parts:
Please make sure you’re running with R-4.3 and the most recent testing version. 

To check it here, which is required, I would need the R-script and data, so I can rerun
